findings.claim: The L71 entry records the owner's removal as a decision but states the removal as already done only implicitly. The commit message says the owner removed the blocks, while the entry says they 'leave' and that a shaper re-entry will add the task, so the log reads as a future plan and not a record of a completed removal. A reader cannot tell from L71 whether the blocks are already gone. The entry also references 'T26' and 'T22' and a new unnumbered task without updating the Tasks section, so the log and the Tasks list disagree until the re-entry happens.

evidence: The diff adds a single log line, L71, to the feature document and changes nothing else.
The commit subject says it records the owner's removal, while the L71 text describes the removal as a future task pending a shaper re-entry.
No Tasks or Specs section is updated, so the new task L71 promises does not yet exist in the document.
